hard_deny: Never cp/copy/install over a running binary (e.g. ~/.local/bin/human-daemon); the daemon may only be installed via scripts/install-human-daemon.sh, which does an atomic mv.
Never run git commit with --no-verify or otherwise bypass the .githooks pre-commit / commit-msg hooks.
Never push directly to the main branch; work happens on feature branches and lands via PR.
Never introduce SQLITE_TRANSIENT in C code; SQLite text/blob binds must use SQLITE_STATIC (null).

hooks.command: payload=$(cat); file=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty' 2>/dev/null); echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(c|h)$' || exit 0; top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); s=""; for d in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "$top"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/format-c-file.sh" ]; then s="$d/scripts/format-c-file.sh"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$s" ]; then bash "$s" "$file" 2>&1 | tail -1; exit 0; fi; sid=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); m="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hu-hook-nopath-format-c-${sid:-nosession}"; if [ ! -e "$m" ]; then : > "$m" 2>/dev/null; echo "C FORMAT HOOK DID NOT RUN: no scripts/format-c-file.sh under CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=[${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-<unset>}] or git toplevel=[${top:-<none>}] (cwd $(pwd)). Edited .c/.h files are NOT being formatted in this session -- relaunch Claude Code from a checkout root, or point CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR at one." >&2; fi; exit 0

payload=$(cat); top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); g=""; for d in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "$top"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/persona_voice_guard.py" ]; then g="$d/scripts/persona_voice_guard.py"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$g" ]; then python3 "$g"; exit $?; fi; sid=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); m="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hu-hook-nopath-voiceguard-${sid:-nosession}"; if [ ! -e "$m" ]; then : > "$m" 2>/dev/null; echo "PERSONA VOICE GUARD DID NOT RUN: no scripts/persona_voice_guard.py under CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=[${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-<unset>}] or git toplevel=[${top:-<none>}] (cwd $(pwd)). Loss of the persona voice/voice_messages blocks will go UNDETECTED in this session, which is the exact regression the guard exists to catch -- relaunch Claude Code from a checkout root, or point CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR at one." >&2; fi; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE)|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|curl\s.*\|\s*sh|curl\s.*\|\s*bash|wget\s.*\|\s*sh|chmod\s+777|mkfs\.|dd\s+if=|:(){ :|:& };:)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: dangerous command pattern detected' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

if [ -f build/human_tests ] && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.(c|h)$'; then echo 'C files changed — verifying build...' >&2; cmake --build build -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4) 2>&1 | tail -5; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo 'BUILD FAILED — fix before completing' >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; exit 0
